steps.title: Read the chargeback
steps.prompt: Read all 5 of these fields of this chargeback (every one is needed): "Chargeback · Network", "Chargeback · Reason code", "Chargeback · Amount", "Chargeback · Deadline" and "Chargeback · Round": card network, reason code, amount, the deadline to push back, and where the case stands.

steps.title: Read the merchant's answer
steps.prompt: Read all 3 of these fields of this chargeback (every one is needed): "Merchant · Name", "Merchant · Answer" and "Merchant · Suggested decision": who the merchant is, what it answered, and what the rules suggest.

steps.title: Compare with the cardholder's evidence
steps.prompt: Read all 4 of these fields of this chargeback (every one is needed): "Evidence · Cardholder answers", "Evidence · Documents", "Evidence · 3-D Secure" and "Evidence · Complete": what the cardholder said and sent, and 3-D Secure on the payment.

steps.title: Push back or accept?
steps.prompt: Push back when the cardholder's evidence answers the merchant's point ("Merchant · Suggested decision" starts with ✓). Accept when the merchant proved its case, or under 50 EUR.

steps.title: File pre-arbitration
steps.prompt: Run "File pre-arbitration" with our answer to the merchant: it goes to Visa Resolve Online or Mastercom. The case waits for the merchant's bank, out of "Merchant answered". The result card shows the pre-arbitration filed and when the merchant's bank must answer.

steps.title: Accept the merchant's answer
steps.prompt: Run "Accept representment": the claim is lost. Only an unauthorised payment was credited before the decision, and it keeps the money (the bank bears the loss); the others got nothing, so nothing is taken back. The result card shows the claim lost and the money kept or never credited.
